current_version: TLS 1.3 (same wire version as RFC 8446; RFC 9846 is a backward-compatible revision)
historical_versions: RFC 8446 (2018; now obsolete); TLS 1.3 drafts (esp. draft-10 and draft-21); RFC 8446bis I-Ds superseded by RFC 9846
model_target_version: TLS 1.3 draft-21 (src/rev21); earlier folder revisions include draft-10 used in IEEE S&P 2016
version_mismatch_risk: HIGH: public Tamarin models target drafts not RFC 8446 and not RFC 9846; RFC 9846 adds MUST-level changes (no KeyShare reuse; forbid TLS 1.0/1.1 negotiation; KeyUpdate limits; terminology master->main). A draft-21 lemma does not license a claim about RFC 9846.
notes: Papers: S17 (draft-10) S18 (draft-21). Current spec S01. Historical first standard S02.

current_standard: RFC 5246 is the TLS 1.2 protocol text but is obsolete as the TLS specification; RFC 9846 still states requirements that optionally affect TLS 1.2 implementations
historical_versions: RFC 4346 (TLS 1.1); RFC 2246 (TLS 1.0); SSL 3.0 (non-IETF); RFC 8996 deprecates TLS 1.0/1.1
public_model_name: no dedicated current-standard Tamarin/Scyther model recorded in this ledger for full TLS 1.2
version_mismatch_risk: HIGH if a TLS 1.2 or draft-TLS-1.3 result is narrated as TLS 1.3/RFC 9846 security
notes: Use only as historical contrast (S03). Do not treat RFC 5246 being obsoleted as meaning TLS 1.2 has vanished from deployments.

current_standard: RFC 7296 (STD 79; October 2014) plus later updates RFC 7427/7670/8247/8983/9370/9827
historical_versions: RFC 4306 (original IKEv2); RFC 4718 (clarifications); RFC 5996 (IKEv2bis before STD); IKEv1 RFC 2409
public_model_name: Cremers ESORICS 2011 Scyther suite; mnm-team Tamarin Minimal IKEv2
model_target_version: Scyther paper: IKEv2 as of RFC 4306/5996 era (2011). Tamarin repo: Minimal IKEv2 initiator (RFC 7815) optionally with IKE_INTERMEDIATE draft

notes: Architecture parent is RFC 4301 (S04). SIGMA (S12) is the cryptographic rationale for signature modes not a byte-level RFC.
